boot1_contradiction.prior_position_basis: chain of 5 confirmations seeded by a route-wide REACQUIRED at mm52; no operator declaration and no independent fix anywhere in the lineage
boot1_contradiction.cause_detail: The navigator has no amplitude or duration criterion. Its only phantom test is positional (hi + 30 < next spacing), so a weak, short, wrong-pole event is recognised as a phantom ONLY when the corridor happens to be narrower than one interval. Here the corridor was 418 mm - wider than the ~305 mm interval - so the positional test did not fire, no pole-matching candidate existed inside the corridor, and the run stopped. Not sensing (the firmware quarantined the same event), not envelope coverage (the timing test was never reached), not dt semantics (dt was 303 ms).

stopping_necessary.detail: Given the information the model uses, stopping was the correct fail-safe: it had no basis to place the event. It was not necessary in the physical sense - the event carries the ghost signature (peak 44 vs genuine >= 104, duration 42 ms vs genuine >= 116) and a signature-aware navigator had grounds to hold it as a suspect. That is recorded as a finding, NOT implemented here.

boot1_contradiction.c5_exercise_claim_corrected: The iteration-3 report credited 51 ghost events to C5. The replay stopped after 85 of 4726 events, so the navigator only ever saw 2 of them. The remaining 49 were never processed and are not evidence of anything.
